reuse.why: Builds occurrences with the shared recurConfigToRSchedule/RSchedule and applies weekend handling through the shared getOccurrenceAfterWeekendRule, the same helpers getUpcomingDates and schedule-template use.

duplication.why: No rule logic is copied; the RSchedule construction and captureBreadcrumb try/catch mirror getUpcomingDates as a small parallel scaffold.

placement.why: Handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts and is registered in SchedulesHandlers like its sibling.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and commented; the hard-coded two-day widening encodes knowledge of the weekend rule's maximum shift outside that rule.
